title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
script:
Fifteen billion three hundred million dollars for ADT. Thrive Holdings just bought the security giant.
OpenAI backs the private equity firm leading this massive purchase.
The goal is bringing advanced AI into millions of home security systems.
Thrive Holdings structured the buyout to expand its footprint in consumer tech markets.
This cash deal values the massive acquisition at fifteen billion three hundred million dollars.
Would you trust an AI with your front door?
